text: Borealis Motors: workers at the company's only plant have voted to strike from 1 August; the union says the stoppage could last six weeks.
Halden Steel: a fire overnight destroyed the rolling mill that makes most of its output; the company expects repairs to take three months.
Coriander Metals: the company has filed for insolvency and its administrators have stopped accepting new orders.
Aster Motors: the government of Region A has banned exports of electric motors until further notice.
Bayline Components: flooding has closed the port it ships through, and carriers say no sailings are expected for a month.
Altamira Resins: a cyberattack has shut down the company's ordering and dispatch systems, and it cannot say when they will be back.
Arden Plastics: the company was named supplier of the year by a national industry association.
Bayline Components: a second assembly line opened in June, adding 30% to the plant's capacity.
Arden Circuits: the company has appointed a new chief executive, who joins from a competitor in September.
Borealis Motors: the company published its price list for next year, with prices unchanged.
Kestrel Polymers: the company has renewed its supply contracts with its main customers for three more years.
Aster Motors: the company has moved its head office to a new building in the same city.
